stories.title: Alaska sports notebook: UAA women’s basketball takes on DI powerhouse in Great Alaska Shootout, Bartlett hockey picks up win
stories.summary: The latest news and notes from across the sports landscape in the 49th state.

stories.title: This weekend around Anchorage: Great Alaska Shootout, Made in Alaska and the Anchorage Zine Fair
stories.summary: Plus there’s Parlor in the Round, a comedy show and a Celtic market.

stories.title: Peltola calls for bipartisanship after winning U.S. Senate race: ‘Alaska has so much to teach the rest of the nation’
stories.summary: Peltola flipped the seat out of Republican control and became the first Democrat to represent Alaska in the U.S. Senate since 2015.

stories.title: Anthropic reportedly prices its IPO at $83 per share, valuing the AI giant at $1.5 trillion
stories.summary: The AI giant decided to barrel ahead with the IPO despite jitters among some investors over market volatility, a potential regulatory crackdown by a Democratic-led Congress next year and growing anti-AI sentiment among the public.

stories.title: Voyager 1 is the first human-made object to reach one light-day from Earth
stories.summary: Launched in 1977, the spacecraft is now so far that its signal, traveling at the speed of light, takes 24 hours to reach our planet.

stories.title: College football Week 12: No AP Top 25 matchups but plenty at stake with playoff race heating up
stories.summary: Point spreads are in the single digits for 14 of the 23 games between Football Bowl Subdivision teams.

stories.title: JSN, Burrow and Gibbs put up milestone performances in NFL’s Week 10
stories.summary: Christian McCaffrey and Ja’Marr Chase also got into the act in a week that required deep searches into the statistical archives.

stories.title: Legislators question Dunleavy administration’s move to grant land rights to gas line developers
stories.summary: The Dunleavy administration is looking to finalize a right-of-way lease for the developers of an 800-mile gas pipeline.

stories.title: GOP-led investigations still underway after Peltola wins Alaska’s US Senate race
stories.summary: A spokesperson with the Alaska Department of Public Safety said Wednesday that the state investigation initiated at the direction of outgoing Republican Gov. Mike Dunleavy is still underway.

stories.title: WATCH LIVE: Alaska is set to complete ranked choice tabulation
stories.summary: The Division of Elections has so far counted 290,003 ballots and election results are planned to be certified on Nov. 25.

stories.title: Judge dismisses assault charges against Anchorage man shot by Wasilla officers
stories.summary: A Palmer magistrate judge on Tuesday cited a lack of probable cause in her decision. Prosecutors say they can refile the charges of third-degree assault.

stories.title: Ex-Red Dog worker files proposed class-action lawsuit seeking unpaid wages for time gearing up, traveling
stories.summary: The lawsuit asserted that Teck Alaska should have paid for time spent getting in and out of safety gear, and the more than three hours it takes for employees to travel round-trip from Anchorage for multiweek shifts.
